title: Bluesky social-app: Notifications v2 (#11933 to #12012)
source: Sixteen merged changes of 12 to 14 October 2026, applied alone in order on the commit before the first: every first-parent commit in that window that touches the notifications screens, the notification queries or the notification lexicons. Notifications v2 itself (#11933, re-landing #11913 after its revert #11932), then its polish, metrics, paging and lexicon follow-ups up to reading subscribed post parents from the grouped notifications lexicon (#12012).
notes:
- Node 24 and pnpm 11, with the repository's locked dependencies in a local pnpm store. There is no internet: nothing new can be installed. Link them first: `pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile --store-dir /pnpm/social-app` (its postinstall generates the lexicon code from `lexicons/`), then compile the translations the tests import: `pnpm intl:compile`.
- The API types come from the vendored lexicons: `lexicons/` and `lexicons.json`, generated into code with `pnpm lexicons:generate`. `lexicons:install` and `lexicons:update` fetch from the network and do not work here; the AppView's lexicons are in the atproto repository's `lexicons/`.
- Run tests a file or a folder at a time: `NODE_ENV=test pnpm exec jest src/state/queries/notifications`. Type-check with `pnpm exec tsc --project ./tsconfig.check.web.json`.
